evidence_use: tissue expression and tissue-specific eQTL/sQTL evidence
claim_limit: GTEx association or expression does not prove the target gene mediates either trait

evidence_use: checksum-locked cis-eQTL/sQTL summary statistics and fine-mapping
claim_limit: QTL association requires formal colocalization and context matching

evidence_use: credible-set annotation L2G features target and disease context
claim_limit: L2G and integrated scores rank evidence but are not causal proof

evidence_use: brain eQTL expression chromatin and cell-context evidence
claim_limit: accession release tissue and permission state must be locked per use

evidence_use: released assay files regulatory annotations and perturbation evidence
claim_limit: ENCODE overlap or assay activity alone does not establish trait mediation

evidence_use: candidate cis-regulatory elements and biosample activity
claim_limit: cCRE overlap is regulatory annotation not proof of a target gene

evidence_use: cell-type and cell-state expression evidence from exact experiments
claim_limit: expression is contextual support and does not establish mediation

evidence_use: discovery of pQTL and other molecular-QTL studies followed by primary-source verification
claim_limit: catalog presence is not a substitute for exact summary statistics or colocalization

evidence_use: curated human pathways and gene-to-pathway mappings
claim_limit: pathway membership is annotation and does not establish a trait mechanism

evidence_use: accession-level Perturb-seq CRISPR model-system and functional assay evidence
claim_limit: model-system evidence must preserve organism cell context perturbation and endpoint limitations
